title: Cueva Alux - Sprouse 2014
credits: Cueva Alux, Xpuha, Quintana Roo. Surveyed 14-22 August 2013 by Aaron Addison, Alan Chuc, Nico Hauwert, Mike Lace, Scott Linn, Barbara Luke, Peter Sprouse, Terri Sprouse, Liliana Viola; drawn by Guinevere McDaid, Sam Meacham and Peter Sprouse. Length 494 m (AMCS Activities Newsletter 37, p. 123, 2014)
sistemaWhy: As in the database's history (its 2013-08 'Survey of Cueva Alux' entry is on X-pu Ha) and the other AMCS Xpuha caves (Imix, Dos Amores). The map itself only says 'Xpuha, Quintana Roo': nothing on it ties Cueva Alux to Sistema X-pu Ha, nor to the sistema 'Alux' (-L_4G8qOQnGiPrcgqUaD), which is the Grutas de los Aluxes at Puerto Aventuras (maps/aluxes.json) - a different cave.

walls.why: plan walls, pillars and islands (dashed where uncertain or open)

notWalls: width 0.29 black: floor detail (breakdown, slopes, flowstone), the cross-sections and their brackets, leaders; 0.29 grey: stipple; 0.14: the water's edge inside the passages, the long profile at the bottom left; 0.4: scale bar; 1.0 and 2.29: page frames; pale blue fills: water, bright blue: the sumps

exclude.why: page caption (Cueva Alux, Xpuha, AMCS Activities Newsletter 37)

entrances.name: Entrada
entrances.why: the yellow ladder (with the drip line of the entrance below it), right of the 'Entrada' label; the only entrance on the map. No database cave.

symbols.why: Vector map: labels are real PDF text (page.get_text), positions in PDF points; build_layer.py doesn't read symbols yet. No depths (shallow lakes), no bones (searched: no bones icon, no bone text, no legend), no water-flow arrows (the small flag-like ticks are UIS slope/ledge marks, not flow). The four 'sump' labels sit at the bright-blue sump ends.

unverified: No position for any part of this cave: Entrada Alux is not in the database or OpenStreetMap, the sistema X-pu Ha has no position, and no placed map shows it. The single control point below is a NOMINAL anchor (the OpenStreetMap 'XPuha' node, 20.473665 N, 87.257026 W, the same one maps/imix.json uses) only so the pipeline can run: the geometry is NOT on the ground. To fix: a field GPS of the Entrada (its ladder).

controlPoints.name: NOMINAL anchor at the Entrada's ladder (not a real position: see 'unverified')
